protocol.command_timeline_window: a sample with dt_s >= 0.9 * declared 0.5 s interval, available at action start + offset_s + frozen 0.050 s pad, with at least another declared interval before action end
protocol.task_sampler_window: two consecutive task-container samples wholly inside the exec action, followed by at least one median native sample interval before action end

selection.sqlglot100: the 100 trace_file paths selected by results.jsonl; all tasks successful
selection.swe100: the 100 trace_file paths selected by results.jsonl

gate.basis: SQLGlot100 alone exceeds both command/task coverage thresholds for the 0.5 s timeline and the trace-side finite-quota screen
gate.next_decision: measure one real native Docker/cgroup CPU and memory update before defining or fitting any action policy
